_comment: LANTERNFOLD - a shadow-puppet world. A walk-and-wonder world cut from paper: flat, layered silhouettes against a warm amber sky, all lit by one great lantern at the north end, which throws a shadow of whatever stands before it onto a cliff-face screen (ShadowScreenView, spec 'view': 'shadow_screen'). Nine regions: Paper Landing (where you arrive), Long Shadow, Moon Hill, Marionette Lane, Cutout Village, Reed Pools, Far Wood, Near Wood and the Footlights (the stage). It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own paper terrain + litter atlas, trees in three depths (tree entries [x, y, kind]: far/mid/near), an ink pool, cut-out props, one great lantern that glows. Its secret is a mural with a bird missing: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'shadow'). Generated by tools/gen_lanternfold_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_lanternfold.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: A world cut from paper, and lit by one great lantern. Everything throws a shadow here, and the cliff keeps them. Follow the lit posts north, to where the light gathers.

props.label: the great lantern
props.lore: The great lantern. Its paper is as thin as a held breath, and the flame inside has never once needed trimming. Whatever stands between it and the cliff is on the screen, whether it likes it or not.

props.label: a notice board
props.lore: A paper notice, pinned straight. 'WELCOME TO LANTERNFOLD. Everything here is cut from paper and lit by one lantern, far to the north, which throws a shadow of whatever stands before it onto the cliff. Walk north. Tap the lit ground to stand your companion in the light, and watch the cliff. The cliff has a mural, and the mural has a gap. A companion's shape is on the little chip at the bottom right.'

props.label: a painted notice
props.lore: 'TONIGHT: THE CROSSING. A flock of birds against the moon. (One is missing. The painter said it would come when it was ready.) Please stand in the light and see: nearer the lantern, a shadow is bigger; to one side, it slides. Things that walk throw their shadows on the ground. A bird's shadow is up in the air, where a bird belongs.'

props.label: a puppeteer's cart
props.lore: A little cart with a curtain, and a stage the size of a bread-box lit by one tiny lamp. The puppeteer is nowhere about, but the stage is set: a cut-paper moon, and room for a bird.

props.label: a paper moon on a pole
props.lore: A crescent of pale paper on a pole, turning very slowly. It is the moon from the mural, or its cousin.

props.label: a cut-out tower
props.lore: A tall paper tower with one lit window at the top. Whoever lives there has been up all night, cutting out stars.

props.label: a paper house
props.lore: A flat paper house with a lit window. You walk round the side and it is exactly as thin as it looks, which is very. The lamplight in the window is real, though.

props.label: a paper house
props.lore: A cut-out house, dark against the amber, a warm window in each side. Someone has pinned a paper cat to the sill.

props.label: a paper house
props.lore: A house made of one sheet of paper, folded into a roof. The door is a slit of light. You decide it is rude to knock.

props.label: a paper puppet
props.lore: A little paper puppet on a stick, arms on pins. Its eye is a pinprick of warm light. It looks, for a moment, at you.

props.label: a paper puppet
props.lore: A paper puppet with a red coat, held up by nobody. Somebody must have propped it here to watch the stage.

props.label: a paper puppet
props.lore: A puppet with one arm raised, as if it were about to say something and then thought better of it.

props.label: a footlight
props.lore: A small paper lantern on a crooked post. A row of them marks where the great lantern's light begins.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Lanternfold'). reveal.type 'shadow': the great lantern at reveal.lantern projects whatever stands in its light onto the face (reveal.face) (ShadowCast); the companion, stood on the lit ground by a tap, throws its CURRENT form's shadow; the bird's, held aloft by reveal.hover and from near reveal.spot, fills the gap in the mural (MuralGuide), and the door in the cliff opens on the prop (ShadowDirector / SecretDirector). The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A little bird cut from one sheet of paper, wings up, on a stick. It is dark against the light and warm in the hand, as if it had just flown out of the lantern. Your companion looks at it for a long moment, and then at the cliff, and then at its own shadow.

lines.arrive: You step into the lantern's light, and your shadow flies up onto the cliff. Everything in the light throws one. Tap the lit ground to stand your companion in it, and watch the screen.
lines.stage: Your companion goes and stands where you pointed, and stays until you call it.
lines.shadow: Its shadow is on the screen now, and moves when it moves. Nearer the lantern it grows; off to one side it slides.
lines.notice: Your companion stops and looks up at the mural. A flock of birds, and one of them missing.
lines.close: The gap in the flock glows. A bird's shadow, nearly where it belongs.
lines.wrong: Its shadow stands on the ground. The missing bird is in the air. It would need wings.
lines.holding: The shadow holds still in the gap, and the paper warms round it.
lines.called: Your companion trots back to you. Tap the lit ground to stand it in the light again.
lines.let_go: Your companion lets the stage go and comes to walk with you again.

reveal.reveal_line: The shadow settles into the gap like a bird coming home, and ink spreads through the paper to keep it. A door in the cliff swings open on warm light, and something small is waiting on its threshold.

secret.found_line: The mural was never missing a bird, only a shadow, and yours was the right one to lend. The little paper bird goes home with you.

keepsake.label: a paper bird on a stick
keepsake.line: A bird cut from a single sheet of paper. Hold it up to the lamp and it throws a bird on the wall, and your companion, in whatever shape, watches it fly.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
